en.title: Minimize the Sum of Segment Maximums with Exactly K Segments
en.description:
Partition the array, preserving order, into exactly K non-empty contiguous segments, minimizing the sum of the segment maximums; this is not minimizing the maximum segment sum.

This site independently compiled the standard I/O and the solution; supplements for missing source bounds and example corrections are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n K, and the second line contains n numbers. The original bounds are 1<K≤n<300 and 1<a[i]<10^5, yet the original example contains 1; to accommodate that example, this site uses 2≤K≤n≤299 and 1≤a[i]≤99999, keeping the entire original strict domain.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 6; 6; 11. Checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Advance the DP segment by segment, enumerating the start of the last segment and extending leftward while maintaining that segment's maximum.
